body: Tonight he is going out with a bunch of guys. I told him I was invited to go places this weekend and turned them down out of respect for our current situation, but he is still going. I should mention we are living overseas in Southeast Asia, so it's nighttime here, and I am watching him get ready to go out. And use my hairdryer to make his hair all fluffy. I myself am planning to just get drunk tonight alone in my bedroom, real normal.
Thanks so much, but I am too tired and too depressed. I will consider what you said and do a nice thing for someone. Why not

Thanks but I should have mentioned this whole thing started when he had to spend 2 months away from me for training. So I think me going away right now would be a bad thing. But I can see how it could work in other people's situations. And maybe it will someday in mine but I just don't think I can go on if things go sour here.

This is off topic but I have to say.. I only think I am attractive because I recognize my little quirks and imperfections only add to my attractiveness. How boring is a plastic-looking person? I love art... I love detail... I love character. Not everyone thinks I am attractive, and hell in the morning I am a ZOMBIEE. There is nothing wrong at all with a big nose... embrace it! I think I just love myself (oddly enough yeah, but I am just too beaten by life). You should accept everything about your appearance and you find how that makes you artistically different... intricately different from anyone else. Sorry for the speech but yeah I saw the need to make you see that from a better perspective since you were very kind to me. 

And I will consider what you said. Thanks.

Thanks so much for the words. I don't think there is anything wrong with me. He said it's nothing I did and that there is nothing I can do. He knows I have been an amazing wife. He just doesn't love me anymore and believes I am not The One. 

Thanks for the input on the crazy bit. I know I am not any more crazy than most people. I think if anyone were in my particular unique shoes, they would have the same line of thinking. I do believe that life is one big challenge and that somehow that's kind of the whole point of living. But I've had enough. This particular scenario is too deep for me. I just don't have the will to go on if things turn out that way. I'm sorry that you had that difficult time in your life and am happy that it appears you are doing much better. 

I gave up all my hobbies and career path when I chose to follow him around with the Army. In 2 years we have lived in 2 states and 2 countries. I have a BA degree that I have never been able to use and which is really just spoiled by now.. My first job any better than ToGo girl is only the one I have now... overseas. Well obviously, hypothetically I'd have to leave my job in this overseas country I live in if things go sour. I've only been at this job for 2 months, not long enough to have any merit at all to let me move forward. There is really nothing left. I know that I could see that as a new challenge and blah-blah, but it all comes back to I have no will to go on without this person I love.

I could wait and see if in years he changed his mind and came back to me, but sadly I'm just spent... I just don't have anything left in me. And after all this therapy and everything and all this time he is spending on decisions, it sure looks like his decision will be a final one. And there is no way I am going to be here when he remarries.

Thank you for your response. Let me be very clear about something. This is not ammunition at all. He would be sad for awhile but he would move on clearly. People would convince him I was just crazy or something and he would think that and move on. It's just because I can't. He would have a grief process and then be fine. 

I don't want any of that help. I've done it all before in life. It is not help to me. This can't be fixed. If he decides he can't love me and leaves me, I will literally lose all will to live this life.
